doc.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Favorite setting and a joke about Sonny Rollins
summary: He prefers a quartet with a good horn player; banter about Sonny Rollins.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: My favorite setting would be just playing the piano in about a quartet with a good horn player. Maybe one or maybe two. With Sonny Rollins or somebody like that. Well not Sonny — the Sonny Rollins that I used to know. I hope he doesn’t hear that. Are you going to interview him?
We won’t edit it but we won’t show it to him.
